root_cause.text: The `ndisc_router_discovery` function in `net/ipv6/ndisc.c` reads and writes the `in6_dev->ra_mtu` field without any locking, causing a data race between concurrent IPv6 neighbor discovery processing on different CPUs.
root_cause.evidence: KCSAN report in the commit message shows a concurrent read (at line 1558) and write (at line 1559) of the same memory location (`in6_dev->ra_mtu`) in `ndisc_router_discovery`, and the patch adds `READ_ONCE`/`WRITE_ONCE` to annotate this race.
